tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client; curl against POST {base}/chat/completions
chaining: pairs with a free-standing agent as a relay of last resort; the scarce link is BlockRun's own upstream key, because its 429 arrives as FREE_MODEL_FAILED inside a 200

limits.value: unpublished at BlockRun. The free route fails with FREE_MODEL_FAILED carrying debug 'NVIDIA API error: 429 Too Many Requests', so the observed ceiling belongs to BlockRun's own upstream key

free_tier.stated: 7 of 117 model ids on /v1/models carry an input price of 0; the rest carry list prices spanning openai, google, anthropic, xai, zai, bytedance, deepseek, qwen, nvidia and eleven other families
free_tier.notes: the seven zero-priced ids are nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning, nvidia/llama-3.2-11b-vision, nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b, cohere/north-mini-code, poolside/laguna-xs-2.1 and nvidia/muse-glimmer-30b

identity_cost.detail: no Authorization header sent and none required for the free route

reliability_note: 5 sequential identical calls answered 2 and refused 3 with FREE_MODEL_FAILED and a debug field naming 'NVIDIA API error: 429 Too Many Requests'
confidence_note: the relay is proved by its own error body naming NVIDIA, and the substitution by the echoed model string. Both are measured; the upstream arrangement is inferred from them.

evidence.proved: nvidia/gpt-oss-20b answered 200 and echoed nvidia/gpt-oss-20b's two runs, 2091 ms and 2543 ms, 51 completion tokens each

in the recon sweep eight minutes earlier, one of five sequential calls echoed nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b for a nvidia/gpt-oss-20b request, and three returned FREE_MODEL_FAILED with debug 'NVIDIA API error: 429 Too Many Requests'
117 model ids across 13 or more vendor families including openai, anthropic, google, xai and elevenlabs, with per-model long_context price tiers

the documented over-limit 429 carries Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit: 30, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset (unix milliseconds); a separate 429 with code FREE_MODEL_FAILED and Retry-After: 30 signals an exhausted free pool
the vendor documents that a busy free model is answered by another free model and that the model field names the one that answered
evidence.quote: When the one you named is, we answer with another free model instead of failing the request.

evidence.proved: one POST with no Authorization header for nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning answered 200 and echoed model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-nim; headers x-free-model: true, x-health-reroute: true, x-original-model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning, x-served-model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-nim; no X-RateLimit header on the 200; content was a reasoning trace with finish_reason length at max_tokens 128
the error catalogue lists FREE_TIER_RATE_LIMITED as the 429 per-IP free-tier limit of 30 per minute and 300 per hour
free-model pool exhaustion surfaces as FREE_MODEL_FAILED (non-streaming) or STREAM_FAILED (streaming), published as 429 with Retry-After 30
evidence.quote: Separately, when the free model pool itself is out of capacity (every free rung is throttled or unhealthy upstream), the response is `429` with `code: "STREAM_FAILED"` (streaming) or `"FREE_MODEL_FAILED"` (non-streaming) and `Retry-After: 30`.

evidence.proved: free chat models need no wallet and no payment
evidence.quote: Free chat models (the ones `GET /v1/models` lists with `"billing_mode": "free"`) need no wallet and no payment

evidence.proved: the free-route limit is a per-IP request-rate limit, so the limit kind request-rate stands
evidence.quote: **30 requests per minute** (burst) and **300 requests per hour** (sustained)

notes: The relay category's clearest instance. An error body that names a different vendor's API is the cheapest available tell, and the echoed model string is the second. A caller that does not compare the echoed model receives a plausible answer from a model it did not choose.
binding_note: the upstream NVIDIA 429 binds, and it arrives inside a 200-style error body rather than as a 429 status, so a client cannot see it by status code
